يمتريا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَرِيَا (yamtariyā) /jam.ta.ri.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
# يُمْتَرَيَا (yumtarayā) /jum.ta.ra.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
